title: When more measurement is not more evidence

validation.citation_audit_runtime_output: C2_CITATION_AUDIT PASS refs=22 all_cited=true section_coverage=true manuscript=v8

conceptual_spine.stance: Familiar performance metrics are conditioned on earlier measurement choices and losses; the v8 contribution is not that conditionality itself is new, but a prospective claim-specific rule for choosing the next measurement intervention class.
conceptual_spine.synthesis: claim-specific distinction-flow diagnosis mapped to intervention class; conditioning-set dependence is the starting structure, not the novelty claim
conceptual_spine.core_prediction: Given a predeclared claim and equal-cost measurement expansions, diagnosis of the limiting interface before collecting new data should predict whether the best intervention class is earlier capture, a new separating axis, target-relevant information or a new failure domain.
conceptual_spine.operational_rule: Before collecting more data, ask what distinction the next measurement must create or preserve for the conclusion to change.
